title: 空着的那把椅子
acts: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Rain shines on the pavement outside Oliver's bookshop.
nodes.translation: 雨刚下过，Oliver 的书店门外，路面还亮着。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: You found it. I nearly sent my pigeon directions.
nodes.translation: 你找到了。我差点就把那套鸽子路线发给你。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: The pigeon was outside the wrong pub.
nodes.translation: 鸽子停在了另一家酒馆外。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Unreliable. Always has been.
nodes.translation: 不可靠。一直这样。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Inside, Nora removes a name from the reading list.
nodes.translation: 进了店，Nora 正从名单上划掉一个名字。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Nora
nodes.text: The bus is stuck in traffic. He says to go on without him.
nodes.translation: 公交堵路上了。他说别等他。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Have you got someone to fill the slot?
nodes.translation: 那少一个人，谁补上？

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Nora
nodes.text: We could just finish a bit earlier.
nodes.translation: 早点散场也行啊。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Oliver's folded page slips from his coat pocket.
nodes.translation: Oliver 的外套口袋里滑出一张折过的纸。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: Is that for tonight?
nodes.translation: 那是今晚要念的？

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: It's mine. I thought I might read it tonight.
nodes.translation: 我写的。原本想今晚试着念念。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He smooths the page with his palm, then covers the last line.
nodes.translation: 他用手掌把纸压平，拇指盖住了最后一行。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 你的选择
nodes.text: What catches your interest?
nodes.translation: 你想先弄清什么？

choices.text: Ask to see the first sentence.
choices.translation: 问问能不能看看第一句。

review.context: Oliver 带来了小说，却还没报名朗读。
review.outcome: 你先听到了十二号那扇窗，也听见 Oliver 说，自己每念一遍就想把后面改一遍。

choices.text: Ask Nora what the missing reader was going to read.
choices.translation: 问问 Nora，没到的那位原本要念什么。

review.context: 朗读名单临时少了一人。
review.outcome: 你问起那首缺席的海诗，Oliver 自己提了那条街，又请 Nora 把名单先留在桌上。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Every morning, the man at number twelve opened his window.
nodes.translation: 每天早上，十二号屋子的那个人都会先打开窗。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Before he checked the weather.
nodes.translation: 然后再看天气。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: Why that way round?
nodes.translation: 为什么反着来？

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: I don't know. It made sense when I wrote it.
nodes.translation: 不知道。写的时候我觉得挺顺的。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: The paper has gone soft along the fold.
nodes.translation: 那张纸来回折了好多次，折痕都软了。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: I change what happens next every time I read it out loud.
nodes.translation: 我每念一遍，就想把后面改一遍。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Nora
nodes.text: A sea poem. We already have two sea poems.
nodes.translation: 海的诗。前面已经有两首海的诗了。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: Were all three sea poems going to be read in a row?
nodes.translation: 本来打算把三首讲海的诗连着念？

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Mine has a street. Just one street.
nodes.translation: 我这篇有一条街。就一条。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Nora looks at the page. Oliver grips its folded edge.
nodes.translation: Nora 看向那页纸。Oliver 捏紧了折边。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Nora
nodes.text: Can we put it between the seas?
nodes.translation: 能放在两片海中间吗？

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: I could try. Will you leave the list here?
nodes.translation: 我可以试试。名单能先搁这儿吗？

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: I want to read it. I also want a small power cut.
nodes.translation: 我想上去念。也挺想现在突然停个电的。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Nora
nodes.text: Emergency lamps. Sorry.
nodes.translation: 有应急灯呢。你没戏。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: The first reader asks for water. Nora gives him her glass.
nodes.translation: 第一个要念的人说想喝水。Nora 把自己的杯子递给他。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: If I lose my place, just give me a second.
nodes.translation: 我要是找不到念到哪儿了，等我一下就行。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: Nora
nodes.text: I'll put the sea poem next. Want to go after it? Just nod.
nodes.translation: 下一个念讲海的那首。想排在后面，你就点个头。

nodes.location: 伦敦 · 书店里的雨夜
nodes.speaker: 你的选择
nodes.text: The chair will be free after the sea poem.
nodes.translation: 那首诗念完，椅子就空出来了。

choices.text: I'll sit here. You can see me from the chair.
choices.translation: 我就坐这儿，你抬眼就看得见。

review.context: Oliver 想读，也担心还没写好的小说。
review.outcome: Oliver 点头上台，中间被笑声打乱，后来把纸袋留在故事里，跳过了写在纸边的最后一行。

choices.text: Let's hear the sea poem and take it from there.
choices.translation: 先听那首讲海的诗吧，后面再看。

review.outcome: Oliver 没上台。散场后他只念给你听，念到纸袋里的衬衫时，你才知道那人要去面试。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Nora sees his nod. After the poem, Oliver takes the chair.
nodes.translation: Nora 看见他点头。诗一念完，Oliver 就坐到了那把椅子上。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Sorry. Could you leave that glass there?
nodes.translation: 不好意思，那杯水能先放这儿吗？

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He takes a sip. The paper still shakes against his knee.
nodes.translation: 他喝了一口，手里的纸贴着膝盖，还是在抖。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: At number twelve, he opened the window before breakfast.
nodes.translation: 十二号那个人吃早饭前，先把窗打开了。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Across the road, there was a paper bag on the bakery chair.
nodes.translation: 马路对面，面包店门口的椅子上搁着个纸袋。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: He went downstairs in his slippers.
nodes.translation: 他穿着拖鞋就下了楼。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: He'd brought a spoon. He'd forgotten his keys.
nodes.translation: 他带了把勺子。钥匙没带。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: A laugh from the back. Oliver loses his place.
nodes.translation: 后排有人笑了一声。Oliver 一下找不到念到哪儿了。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: He set the paper bag down by the kerb.
nodes.translation: 他把纸袋从椅子上拿下来，放在路沿边。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Then he sat down to see who would come out for it.
nodes.translation: 然后坐下来，等着看谁会出来拿。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: The last line runs up the margin. Oliver skips it.
nodes.translation: 最后一行挤在纸边上。Oliver 跳了过去。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: One person claps. The rest join in a beat later.
nodes.translation: 有个人先拍了手，其他人的掌声慢了一拍才跟上。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: I heard the laugh. Couldn't see who it was.
nodes.translation: 我听见有人笑。没看清是谁。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: I wanted to know what was in the bag.
nodes.translation: 我倒想知道袋子里是什么。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: His thumb goes straight back to the last line.
nodes.translation: 他的拇指又按回了最后一行。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Oh. That's the line I didn't read.
nodes.translation: 哦。我刚才跳过去的就是那句。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Nora calls the next name. Oliver exhales into his cup.
nodes.translation: Nora 叫了下一个名字。Oliver 捧着杯子，出了口气。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: The sea poem turns out to be about a broken kettle.
nodes.translation: 那首海的诗，讲的竟然是一只坏水壶。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: The shop's kettle made that sound for weeks.
nodes.translation: 店里那水壶也响了好几个星期，就这个声儿。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: By the applause, he has the page out on his lap again.
nodes.translation: 台下鼓掌的时候，他已经把那页纸拿出来搁在腿上了。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Afterwards, Nora stacks the cups. Oliver stays seated.
nodes.translation: 散场后 Nora 忙着把杯子摞起来，Oliver 还坐在那儿。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Will you hear the bit about the chair outside the bakery?
nodes.translation: 你能听我念一段吗？就面包店门口有把椅子那段。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He reads the line about the shirt, still warm from the iron.
nodes.translation: 他念到袋子里那件衬衫，刚熨过，摸着还是暖的。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: What does he need a shirt for?
nodes.translation: 他要衬衫干吗？

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: An interview. He's been out of work since January.
nodes.translation: 要去面试。他一月份就没工作了。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He goes to read the next sentence. No sound comes out.
nodes.translation: 他张嘴想接着念，没出声。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: That's enough for now. Can I sit here a minute?
nodes.translation: 先念到这儿吧。我能在这儿再坐一会儿吗？

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: At the door, he still has the page in his hand.
nodes.translation: 到了门口，那页纸还攥在他手里。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: You sit with him a while. At last he goes to get his coat.
nodes.translation: 你陪他坐了一会儿。他总算起身去拿外套了。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: About the window. I cut the line about the weather.
nodes.translation: 那扇窗。我把看天气那句删了。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: I noticed. I still want to know who's coming for the bag.
nodes.translation: 我听出来了。可我还是想知道谁来拿那个袋子。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He starts to hand you the page, then folds it shut.
nodes.translation: 他把纸往你这边递了一半，又收回来折上了。

nodes.speaker: Nora
nodes.text: I've got a gap next month. Shall I put you down?
nodes.translation: 下个月还空着一个位子。给你报上？

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Yes. Can we leave the title blank for now?
nodes.translation: 好。题目能先空着吗？

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Nora writes his name, then moves down to the next line.
nodes.translation: Nora 写下他的名字，笔尖移到下一行。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: The window. He used to open it before work. That's why.
nodes.translation: 我想起来那扇窗是怎么回事了。他以前上班前都开窗。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: And now he's still doing it?
nodes.translation: 现在他还是照开？

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: I think he still does it at six.
nodes.translation: 我想他还是六点就开。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He lifts the latch. Behind him, the chair faces the room.
nodes.translation: 他抬起门闩。身后那把椅子还朝着听众席。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Did Nora sound disappointed when I didn't go up?
nodes.translation: 我没上去，Nora 好像有点失望？

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: I was looking at you.
nodes.translation: 我光顾着看你了。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He stays by the door and lines up the edges of the page.
nodes.translation: 他留在门边把纸又折了一遍，两边对得齐齐的。
